characters.name: ノア
characters.description: 優しいおじいさん。神様の言葉を信じて大きな舟を作る。
characters.visual_traits: an old man with a long white beard, wearing simple earth-tone natural clothing, gentle innocent facial expressions, large and expressive eyes, soft rounded features

characters.name: 神様
